scope: Post-v12m fixed-prediction correction geometry; one frozen inference audit, no new training or scaling search.
research_question: On fixed v12m P endpoints, is the candidate-early correction locally unfavorable, or does crossing the observed target erase a positive local direction at the original amplitude?

source.source_verification: Require all original 19 input fingerprints and producer code identities, matching run and endpoint manifests, file hashes and strict tensor-state identities. Reconcile every consumed NPZ with summary.outputs and rehash before publication. Reject partial/check sources; checkpoint paths alone or printed logs do not certify outputs.
source.raw_inputs: Use the same original A checkpoint, positive train package, primary and secondary train control packages, scaler, graph, station axis and manifests named by the source identity; no validation or test dataset instantiation.

secondary_context: The same six endpoints on all original fit/selection/audit cohorts. Fit has no controls. No cross-phase paired intervals, state bins or matched-complement search.

geometry.inputs: Raw-flow A, P and Y converted from original FP32 to float64 before r=Y-A and d=P-A. Preserve original y_valid and all predefined candidate H1-H6 prediction support.
geometry.slope: s = sign(r)*d when r != 0; s = -abs(d) when r == 0
geometry.crossing_penalty: o = 2*max(abs(d)-abs(r),0) when r,d have the same nonzero sign; otherwise 0
identities: G(lambda) <= lambda*S for all lambda >= 0 under fixed nonnegative weights

categories_in_order.name: wrong_direction
categories_in_order.condition: r and d nonzero with opposite signs

categories_in_order.name: same_direction_beneficial
categories_in_order.condition: same nonzero sign and abs(d) < 2*abs(r); may cross Y and still improve

geometry.classification: Compare signs without multiplying r*d; use exact zero and equality boundaries in float64. Never zero small r/d or threshold categories by outcomes.
geometry.pooled: sum of cell values divided by N=sum_i n_i
geometry.equal_window: mean over M evaluable windows of each window cell sum divided by its n_i
geometry.category_contributions: Apply the same full-cohort N or window n_i and M denominators to masked category values. Do not sum within-category means. Zero-support windows remain identified with undefined means.
geometry.scientific_boundary: Empirical theorem concerns final-output A+lambda*(P-A), fixed endpoints, fixed observed support, fixed nonnegative weights and lambda>=0 only. It is not a theorem about internal adapter scaling, retraining, elementwise gates or future data.

matched_auxiliary.pair_key: positive_sample_index stored as NPZ ids; never cross-cohort source_indices
matched_auxiliary.pooled: Difference of three cohort-specific total gain/total valid-cell ratios, using original matched cohort support.
matched_auxiliary.equal_triad: Average within-triplet window-MAE gain contrast over triplets where all three early valid counts are positive; disclose all exclusions and each cohort retained cell mass.
matched_auxiliary.bootstrap_cluster: Assign the entire triplet to the matched incident t0 ISO week, as in v12m. Shared draws preserve pairing but do not fully model traffic dependence across different control weeks.
matched_auxiliary.time_sensitivity: For every original phase calendar week, remove every triplet for which ANY member complete support interval [start,end) intersects that week. Recompute each of the three D contrasts in both weightings with deletion counts and cell masses; no extra CI, cherry-picked week or gate.
matched_auxiliary.interpretation: Predictive correction-gain difference, not incident causal effect. A relative advantage cannot rescue negative full-incident absolute gain.

bootstrap.calendar: Original continuous phase ISO-week grid including empty weeks; reconcile saved matrices and deterministic generator.
bootstrap.shared_draws: All models, cohorts, G/S/O and matched contrasts use the same phase weights. Compute ratios and contrast within each draw; never subtract CI endpoints.
bootstrap.interpretation: Pointwise intervals conditional on saved weights, reused development and nine audit weeks. No joint 95 percent mechanism claim, seed independence or new success gate.

replay.model_mode: eval and no_grad; all parameters frozen; no optimizer; state and buffer hashes unchanged
replay.prediction_policy: P equals original adapted V at candidate H1-H6 and native A elsewhere bitwise. Preserve identical report context for native A; never score U(eP).
replay.near_zero_policy: Keep raw S and exact cell categories; abs(S)<=band is NEAR_ZERO_UNRESOLVED. This reporting band is neither an error certificate nor a scientific benefit threshold.
replay.failure_policy: Stop scientific interpretation on source/support/replay/identity failure or reversal of the known negative audit full-incident G(1). Preserve diagnostics; never loosen tolerances after outcomes.

budget.runtime: Measure time, memory and storage during engineering check. Fixed inference may use original GPU environment; no training-time estimate or automatic paid job.

planned_outputs.summary.json: engineering and scientific status separately; all six endpoints, boundaries, hashes, finite-or-null results and no automatic promotion
planned_outputs.report.md: six-row primary table and complete secondary context
planned_outputs.geometry_metrics.csv: phase/cohort/arm/seed/estimand G/S/O, A/P MAE, supports and intervals
planned_outputs.category_contributions.csv: six categories: counts, shares, complete-denominator G/S/O contributions and separate within-category means
planned_outputs.matched_contrasts.csv: three fixed G differences and both estimands with supports and intervals
planned_outputs.matched_week_sensitivity.csv: any-member support-week deletion; remaining mass and D, no extra CI

window_geometry/*.npz.time_mapping: positive-window and unique-incident IDs, incident/cohort t0, complete support start/end; source manifest identity retained

signed_cells/*.npz.d: float64 [K], difference of converted P and A
signed_cells/*.npz.packing: All candidate prediction cells including invalid targets; K excludes protected output regions only. Never pack only beneficial/nonzero/valid cells. Invalid Y excluded from all numeric diagnostics. Shared immutable A/Y blocks may be referenced by hash.

planned_outputs.protocol_snapshot.json: exact byte snapshot of this design baseline
planned_outputs.input_manifest.json: source inputs, consumed artifacts, implementation code hashes and runtime environment

minimum_verification_cases: pooled and equal-window slopes with opposite signs
positive S and negative G without harmful_overshoot cells
tampered checkpoint or manifest or NPZ rejected
no optimizer or gradients or validation or test access
exact protected output and unchanged model state
engineering source rejected for formal mode

decision.engineering_failure: Stop and fix reproducibility before any scientific interpretation.
decision.negative_slope: Record fixed-direction empirical non-rescue under positive uniform final-output scaling, scoped separately to each weighting and endpoint.
decision.positive_slope_negative_gain: Record local empirical opportunity with crossing penalty at original amplitude; do not choose lambda or claim useful or transferable gain.
decision.near_zero_or_mixed: Retain unresolved or differing endpoints/weightings; do not search finer cohorts.
decision.after_one_complete_audit: Close this diagnostic. Preserve v12m negative result. A new model experiment requires a separate hypothesis and unused-data confirmation plan; no automatic training or test authorization.

publication: Read-only source; reject existing output/partial/job paths and symlinks. Publish .partial atomically after checking source and output hashes. Preserve failure.json. Statistics may resume from a verified signed export; no training recovery.
